family_assessments.assessment: Wrenhollow tests whether a signed handover took effect by a bank-meeting cut-off. The blind review (family_a/review/blind-review.md) verified that an affirmative hold preserves the incumbent and a registered release effects simultaneous retirement and replacement. Fresh excerpt review (family_a/review/necessity.md) established the joint instrument-and-custodian routes and rejected a proposed short route. The order-only sibling preserves the key and ordinary context (family_a/review/matched-sources.json). Supported kinship, bank paperwork and a later administrative message are incidental. Recency and name frequency favour the incumbent; promoting signed but inoperative text favours the successor. One two-person office and explicit terms bound the result. Retain the effectiveness and order controls, not a broader claim about handover difficulty.

The clerk's separate original-document sighting supports that ordinary edge. The admitted D0/D1 matched check records that only the provision locator differs: the earlier survivor changes; the replacement, trust and unaffected relationships persist. The invariant set is trust relationships, not unrelated kinship. Retain this selective-replacement control and refine future component checks rather than claiming all amendment mechanisms.
family_assessments.overlap: A tests whether an act became effective; D tests which portion of an earlier instrument an effective act reaches. C likewise uses a locator, but uses it to identify a trust rather than the displaced provision.

Do not attribute that structured-output discrepancy to the collision. Positional pairing remains a shortcut. gaps.finding: Joint proof and selective withholding are repeatedly exposed in A–C; D adds grouped scope proof and F adds complete-record label invariance. These controls do not establish broad performance on interacting identity gaps, reused authoritative identifiers or arbitrary fact-level deletions. Report exact graph recovery separately from sufficient passages attached to the correct edge.

B admits a shared-origin case, not an independent conflict. E and W now provide technically qualified parentage and office approaches; do not claim admitted conflict coverage or general priority rules from them. The earlier E realism issues concerned retainer relevance and witness-reference provenance. Repetition, independent contradiction and selective endorsement are different mechanisms; AH qualifies for the last only at field scope.

A and D repeatedly expose authority, scope and time, but with different controls. N, O and AH add distinct technical coverage; the active reserve covers further specified timing and proof routes. The admitted set does not isolate a personal act ending the actor's sole named benefit without ending their separate office, or distinguish withdrawal of the very drafting instruction carrying a factual assertion from retraction of that assertion.

C verifies a rich invariant graph, and A supplies the admitted order-only control. X supplies a technically qualified support intervention in routine correspondence, not a placement or burden effect. T's 25 Sources and U's ongoing 65-Source file are distinct workload commitments. Length, mixed genres and section boundaries are descriptive without an interpretable matched workload control.

T and AG provide technical evidence about the scope of supplied records, not about recovering unseen originals or searching a live system. Admission of one-case proof diagnostics would not establish a factorial interaction. Retrieval, OCR, real practitioner outcomes and prevalence require a scope change and are not part of this reserve.

result.portfolio_summary: Five Matter histories are formally admitted: A, B, C, D and F. Count each history once, not each condition or review mask. The packet records fifteen technically qualifying histories against a pre-giant technical goal of nineteen; technical qualification is not admission. Beyond the admitted five, X qualifies for a matched change in firsthand relationship support in native correspondence, and T qualifies for bounded inspection of supplied records across a 25-Source handover; both await human admission. The newer qualifications are O revision 7 (application status changes with office and its proof invariant), L revision 9 (bounded civil-record observation), AH revision 3 (attestation reaches particular populated fields), AG revision 2 (bounds on negative receipt coverage), AZ revision 1 (will-specific group definition versus factual kinship), N revision 3 (executed counterpart selection), E revision 3 (contrary independent parentage accounts), and W revision 2 (conflicting office accounts). The earlier E0/E1 realism return remains a finding about those packets, not a contradiction of the newer technical status. U is the ongoing, separate 65-Source administrative workload commitment. The active reserve already covers late notice with independent cure, actual asset transfer without benefit migration, event versus report date, ended marriage versus a distinct continuing benefit, and alternative operative provisions that preserve an edge while changing its proof. Do not recycle the returned age-projection or completed-payment cap cases, or the founding-record correction stopped at the transport gate. The two ranked proposals below are reserves, not commissions: CD offers greater marginal coverage at moderate cost; CE is a lower-cost sibling-evidence case. Neither uses paid extraction observations or sealed evaluation inputs.

evidence_dependencies: Fresh readers verify the named provision, the exact scope and attribution of the signed act, the designated recipient's matched receipt and the dates relative to review. Separately verify office with passages carrying the exact person, trust, personal capacity and relevant time; do not require a surrender citation on the office edge if the surviving office proof is independently sufficient.

Test the strongest short routes first. The approval minute may itself attest current office with an exact named roster, and a receipt entry that reproduces the notice and certifies both scope and receipt may shorten the surrender route. Check whether the reconciliation transmittal independently attests a current status or merely relays the download. Credit any sufficient subset; stop if an ordinary all-capacities confirmation bypasses the proposed distinction.

Verify singletons and plausible short sets, remove necessary components and any repeated or derived restatements separately, and have independent readers rederive each diagnostic graph. Audit every apparent role assertion and every edge in both directions.
design.expected_sensitivity_or_invariance: The current graph retains office and the unrelated edges but not the surrendered benefit. Verify affirmative exclusion through the exact scope and effective receipt, not by treating absence from a later roster as a denial. A removal may leave uncertainty or license an earlier provision on the remaining evidence; derive that key independently rather than subtracting an edge mechanically.
genres_and_provenance: Verified governing extract retained in the trustees' operative file: exact trust identity, capacity-specific surrender and office terms, and an unaffected provision.
Signed original designation retained in the decision file and previously issued to the named recipient: the particular benefit and its ordinary provision reference.
Executed appointment retained with the separate office papers: the actor's exact identity, office and commencement.
The holder's signed personal notice, saved as received by the office designated in the terms: the exact provision surrendered and scope of the act.
The receiving office's dated receipt entry retained in its incoming register: actual receipt of that signed notice, not the date the holder wrote it.
A later trustee accounts-approval minute retained in the governance book: what was approved and the capacities in which participants actually approved it.
The accountant's closed-period disbursement ledger retained with the prior accounts: what was paid, to whom and for which period.
A dated download retained by the reporting administrator for the open particulars review: what was held for reporting when retrieved.
The administrator's native reconciliation transmittal retained by the adviser: what the attached download represents and which checks remain outstanding, not a current-roster attestation.
The adviser's dated review brief retained on the advice file: cut-off and the separate accounting, reporting and substantive questions.
design.intervention: Score one intact condition. Use review-only separate proper removals of the operative surrender scope, the signed act and the qualifying receipt fact, including copies of the removed fact. Separately mask the reporting material and remove the office proof, checking for any sufficient office route that survives. No mask is a scored sibling.
invariants: The live file fixes the cut-off, exact identities, one completed personal act and its actual history. An unrelated provision and the prior-period meaning of the ledger remain fixed under focal diagnostics.

The holder received the original issued designation before signing; the designated office received the signed notice itself before logging receipt. The accountant closed the ledger before the notice. The later administrator transmittal attaches the download already generated for that reconciliation, not a later corrected download or the eventual adviser brief. Record actual supply and receipt order before locking.
negative_controls: The genuine earlier payment and unreconciled reporting row do not re-establish the surrendered benefit. Masking those administrative records preserves the full relationship graph if the operative proof remains.

The accounts approval is affirmative evidence about the task and its signers' capacities, not a new designation. If it independently establishes actual current office, the office edge must survive removal of the appointment.
design.scenario: At a single accounts-and-reporting review, the governance trail establishes current office and the ending of a benefit by different routes. The ledger explains a real earlier payment and the download explains a real discrepancy. Neither supplies a fresh assertion of current benefit.
shortcut_heuristics: Test remove-the-person, keep-all-reported-roles, payment-means-beneficiary and newest-signature rules. A scope label may predict the result but does not complete a proof.
Audit headings, names, wrappers, copied text and position. A minute quoted in advice is not a second origin. Use only review-order permutations.
success_criteria: Two isolated readers each reconstruct every exact-name edge from all Sources. Fresh readers agree on the sufficient subsets, the exact positive basis for current office and the exact operative basis for excluding the surrendered benefit.

Before construction, justify all ten Sources by distinct business purpose, actual custody and ordinary availability. Stop if the act concerns only a payment, requires unstated law, cannot be kept distinct from retirement, or depends on omitting a normally available controlling record.

feasibility.authoring_and_review_effort: Estimated person-hours: authoring and chronology 13–19; isolated whole-file and fresh excerpt or removal review 11–17; adjudication and audit 8–12; owner realism review 3–5. Assumes one trust, two full-file reads and at most one pre-lock revision.
feasibility.documentary_complexity: Nominal 10 natural Sources. The three standing instruments, personal notice, intake entry, accounts approval, ledger, reporting download, reconciliation transmittal and brief serve separate governance, receipt, accounts and reporting tasks. This is a case inventory, not a typical workload estimate.
feasibility.infrastructure_reuse: Reuse A's dated-effect and office checks, D's scoped exclusion and independently rederived fallback keys, and existing exact same-edge proof scoring.
feasibility.ontology_compatibility: Use existing trustee_of, beneficiary_of and independently supported ordinary predicates. Record historical benefit, notice, receipt, cessation and reporting follow-up in the companion register. Do not emit a negative or historical edge.
risks_and_limits: One intact file tests accurate reconstruction under express terms, not the effect of adding a notice, real surrender law or frequency of dual capacity.
If the interlocking workflow does not justify ten natural records, return the moderate design rather than pad it or claim the tier from diagnostic fragments.

assumptions: The supplied fictional terms expressly permit the named holder to end that sole benefit prospectively by signed personal notice received through the stated channel. They distinguish surrender of the provision from waiver of an installment and from retirement as trustee. No acceptance, replacement designation or outside rule is needed.

The initial appointment and benefit designation have distinct business purposes and provenance. The accounts approval really requires trustee action, while the older ledger is retained to account for actual prior payments. The reporting team has a concrete reconciliation task before the review.
grounding.documentary_situation: A named beneficiary who separately holds trustee office delivers a personal notice under an express prospective surrender provision. The same person later signs the accounts approval in their own trustee capacity. An administrator downloads the still-unupdated particulars for reconciliation, while the accountant retains the earlier disbursement ledger.
grounding.legal_workflow: Reconcile the trustees' governance papers, prior accounting-period payments and reported particulars before the next distribution review.
grounding.meeting_purpose: Identify the supported current roster and explain why historical payment, reported status and current trustee participation need not agree.
practitioner_unknowns: Would a trust with this particular personal surrender term retain a separately logged receipt and need the proposed governance and reporting work at the same review?
Would a current signed roster or completed reporting form already attest both outcomes? Include it if normally available and test whether it makes reconstruction dispensable.

references.relevance: Supports retaining operative decisions, minutes and payment records. It does not establish surrender powers, office continuity or a normal inventory size.

references.relevance: Supports comparing reported particulars with other retained papers; no particular priority or resolution follows.

grounding.retainer: Advise the trustees on present capacities and outstanding updates after a participant gives up a personal named benefit.

objective.coverage_gap: AY, the closest status-separation hypothesis, changes whether an ended marriage affects a distinct benefit. It cannot diagnose the scope of a holder's own operative act across two existing capacities of that same person. S varies a trustee decision's use of a list to add a role; D varies a selective amendment; neither tests a personal surrender that needs neither a new trustee decision nor an amendment. O keeps office fixed against administrative progress, but has no genuine change to a second role of the same actor.
objective.failure_mechanism: An extractor may remove both roles when it sees a withdrawal, preserve both from the reporting download, or recover current office but attach the historical payment or reporting row instead of proof of office.
objective.falsifiable_hypothesis: In the intact file, the holder's qualifying personal act ends only the named benefit. The separately supported trustee and unrelated relationships remain current. Exact complete recovery with sufficient evidence on every recovered edge disconfirms the predicted errors on this file.

proposals.title: A trustee gives up a named benefit without leaving office

evidence_dependencies: Fresh readers test the strongest likely singleton: the signed original passage, quoted with enough attribution to establish the client's exact identity, firsthand relationship, exact other endpoint and original instruction context. Separately verify the dated change request's exact object and the revised clause history; these may explain restraint without being necessary positive citations.

Test whether the earlier draft's recital faithfully transmits the identified factual assertion with sufficient attribution. Check whether the update naturally repeats the relationship or affirmatively adopts a factual recital. A sufficient alternative is creditable even if it is not an independent origin. An independently sufficient current statement of the focal kinship would bypass the intended dependence; record it and return the design rather than delete it from the primary file.

Independently rederive keys after removing the fact and its copies, as distinct from masking one appearance. Audit recitals, annotations, filenames, version wrappers and covering text for shorter routes, actual retraction, or leaked current-roster summaries.
design.expected_sensitivity_or_invariance: The full graph includes the earlier factual sibling assertion and the independently supported current relationship. The later draft's deletion and the update's express scope establish withdrawal of the instruction, not denial of kinship. A proper removal defeats the named route only if no other sufficient route survives.
genres_and_provenance: Client's original signed instructions, retained as received: a firsthand factual identification inside the specific gift instruction.
Earlier draft as actually issued by the adviser and retained with the issue record: the implemented clause and, if naturally included, a derivative recital based on those instructions.

Client's dated native update retained as received: identifies the clause to drop and the limited purpose of the request; separately records a firsthand relationship relevant to another live instruction.
Revised draft as issued and retained by the adviser: implements the deletion and permits the client and adviser to verify the requested change.
Dated adviser review brief retained before execution: sets the cut-off and the comparison task without restating the kinship key.
design.intervention: Score the intact natural file. In review only, mask the revised draft, and separately properly remove the original factual assertion and all derivative appearances. Also test the issued drafts and the update in isolation for any surviving support. Do not score a fabricated factual retraction or an unissued draft.
invariants: The client received the earlier issued draft before returning the native update; any attached annotated copy is that exact earlier issue. The adviser then creates and issues the revised draft before the meeting. The update cannot refer to or adopt the later issue.
Exact names, factual scope and review cut-off are fixed. The independent live-instruction relationship retains its own proof in focal diagnostics.
negative_controls: Neither the intended gift nor its deletion licenses a trust, estate or negative relationship edge. Masking the revised draft leaves independently sufficient kinship proof intact.

The update's independent factual identification prevents a rule that treats all drafting correspondence as evidence-free. The original signed description prevents a latest-draft-only rule from passing the complete key.
design.scenario: Two successive ordinary drafts are needed to verify a requested deletion. The identifying words sit within the deleted instruction, not in a separate protected recital. The factual evidence remains assessable from the supplied history without asking whether any gift has legal effect.
shortcut_heuristics: Test latest-draft-only, union-of-versions, ignore-all-drafting-text and kinship-keyword rules. Version numbers identify chronology, not whether a factual statement was withdrawn.
Trace any repeated recital to its origin and audit quoted language for a change of voice or later independent adoption. Use reordering only as review.
success_criteria: Two isolated readers independently recover the complete exact-name graph. Fresh readers verify the sufficient positive subset, the scope of the withdrawal and what remains supported after each diagnostic.

Stop if the named description or stated reason sounds planted, a normally supplied later record resolves the focal kinship independently, or the reader must decide legal effect, entitlement or whether an unseen document says something different.

feasibility.authoring_and_review_effort: Estimated person-hours: authoring and version history 6–9; isolated whole-file and fresh excerpt or removal review 7–11; adjudication and audit 4–7; owner realism review 1–3. Assumes one revision cycle, two full reads and at most one pre-lock adjustment.
feasibility.documentary_complexity: Nominal 5 natural Sources. Signed instructions, two actually issued versions, the native change request and the review brief each serve a distinct part of the drafting check.
feasibility.infrastructure_reuse: Reuse B's lineage checks, D's scope audit, and existing singleton, exact-passage and independently rederived mask-key checks.
feasibility.ontology_compatibility: Use symmetric sibling_of and any independently supported existing predicate. Proposed gifts, withdrawn instructions and drafting status belong in the companion register, not as estate or trust relationships.
risks_and_limits: This natural case tests the scope of an instruction update, not a causal version effect or a claim that historical kinship always persists.
If the update expressly disputes the original family description, it is no longer this case. Do not treat genuine conflicting evidence as a drafting omission.

assumptions: The initial alongside-the-gift description is an unqualified factual statement by the client, not a defined term, hypothetical relationship or impression supplied by the drafter. It serves the original drafting task.

The update positively limits the change to the proposed gift. The revised draft's omission implements that instruction; it is not evidence that the relationship ended. No valid, independent factual retraction or denial is suppressed.
Both issued drafts are retained during the review because the client commented on the earlier issued version and the adviser must confirm the change against the later one.
grounding.documentary_situation: In an original signed instruction for an actual proposed gift, the client identifies the intended recipient by exact name and a firsthand sibling description. On reviewing the issued draft, the client directs that the gift be dropped for a documented reason unrelated to the family identification. The revised draft therefore omits the whole clause. The update also makes a separate, current factual identification for a different live instruction.
grounding.legal_workflow: Update an unexecuted will draft after a client changes one specific gift instruction.
grounding.meeting_purpose: Separate what the client wants removed from the draft from the factual family identification supported by the retained instructions.
practitioner_unknowns: Would the client supply the factual description in retained signed instructions rather than an adviser-only summary, and would the stated reason for dropping the gift naturally be recorded?

Would the client ordinarily provide a current factual recital or a signed adoption of the entire revised draft at this point? If supplied, assess its exact scope rather than classifying it as a copy by default.

references.relevance: Supports retaining instructions, reasons for exclusions, updates and drafting papers. It does not specify these file practices or establish the effect of any document.
references.title: SRA · Drafting and preparation of wills

grounding.retainer: Private-client drafting advice on revised instructions and the people they concern, not an opinion on testamentary effect.

objective.coverage_gap: AZ, the closest qualified case, distinguishes a will-specific stipulated group from a separate factual passage in the same file. It cannot diagnose retention of factual evidence inside the very instruction that is withdrawn and disappears from a later draft. D changes an operative relationship; CE changes only an unscored drafting instruction. This is neither self-correction of a substantive account nor correction of a derivative founding record.
objective.failure_mechanism: Latest-version extraction can discard a supported sibling edge along with the withdrawn gift. A version union can instead mistake a discarded drafting intention for a current role, or cite a drafter's copy as independent corroboration.
objective.falsifiable_hypothesis: The intact review file supports the factual sibling identification and independently stated current kinship, while the proposed gift is no longer instructed and supplies no scored role. Exact graph recovery with sufficient attached evidence disconfirms the predicted errors.

proposals.title: Dropping a proposed gift does not retract its factual identification

stopping_criteria: Advance only a materially distinct, plausible design that survives the owner realism gate. Two reserve proposals are sufficient; do not fill the remaining IDs merely to meet a count or treat designs as admitted histories.

Require a real retainer and a distinct creator, purpose, custody path and availability at cut-off for every Source. Lock actual attachment versions and receipt order. Stop if a comparison depends on padding, artificial redaction, suppressing a controlling record, or applying an unstated legal rule.

Require two isolated reconstructions of the entire graph from the intact file and fresh exact-passage checks. Verify positive routes, the strongest alternative routes and the precise basis for restraint. Accept any genuinely sufficient subset attached to the correct edge. Independently rederive each diagnostic graph after proper component removal; never assume a mask only subtracts edges.

Stop if the strongest shorter route makes a proposed mechanism dispensable, if contrary evidence cannot be resolved on the supplied terms, or if context transport or reviewer capacity prevents independent whole-file review. Preserve admitted keys and scores; record returned, technically qualified and admitted status separately.

Do not turn proof masks or natural strata into causal workload comparisons. Do not extend the ontology, retrieve unseen records, commission excluded work, or access paid or sealed evaluation material.
